Hi Sofia — copying a quick checklist and what we need to enable a full, interactive demo. Basics first:

Required for hands-on sandbox or production-connected demo:
- Completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (attached).
- NDA on file (signed PDF or DocuSign).
- Details for SSO (IdP metadata) if you want us to show an SSO-enabled tenant.
- If you intend to test with real PHI/PII, we need an executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) — procurement should flag this.

If procurement cannot finish before 9/2, we can still run a 30-minute executive session that covers:
- Product capabilities + architecture (no tenant access)
- Performance/latency benchmarks relevant to CareNow

Please note expected timelines: once we receive the questionnaire, our security intake review often takes 3–5 business days (faster if IdP metadata and procurement contact are included).

Next steps for speed:
1) Send the signed NDA via DocuSign link or attach PDF here.
2) Procurement can fill the onboarding form and upload to the vendor portal.
3) Rishi (copied) will triage any questions from your procurement team directly.

Happy to run the exec overview on 9/2 if that helps keep momentum.
